copy.tagline: Ten questions, fifteen seconds, up to twelve players.
copy.description: 120 questions across six categories, in Turkish and English. Faster answers score more, and correct answers in a row unlock a streak bonus. Chase a record alone, take turns on one device or have everyone answer at once in an online room.
controls: Tap the right option or press one of the keys 1 to 4.
A correct answer is worth 100 points, plus up to 100 more for the time left.
Each correct answer in a row raises the streak bonus by 20 points.
On a shared device, each player answers in turn while the others look away.

text.passDevice: Hand the device to {name}; everyone else, look away.
text.waitingOthers: Answer locked in, waiting for the others.
